mutations.name: a codec blip frame is diffed as itself
mutations.find: prev && isCodecBlip(prev, held, next) ? prev : held
kills: frameDiffs through the exec seam a one-frame codec blip on a still picture a keyframe blip that strays 5 levels and returns the next frame is no change

mutations.name: a blip may move pixels any number of levels
kills: frameDiffs through the exec seam a one-frame codec blip on a still picture a one-frame flash that moves pixels 40 levels still counts as change

mutations.name: a blip need not return to the frame before
kills: frameDiffs through the exec seam a one-frame codec blip on a still picture a small step that stays on the next frame still counts as change
